threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid walking on the cycle lanes. Locals glide past on their bikes like it's a game of dodgeball. Welcome to the jungle.
Caught a bloke in a Puma tracksuit debating with a traffic cone on the 77 last night. Brixton's late-night characters never fail to amuse.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the guy selling flowers from his bicycle at 1 AM, I knew I was home in Neukölln. Only here would that feel completely normal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a 24-hour 'Kebab to go' at 3 AM that serves you with a side of techno beats. It's a cultural rite of passage.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the exact BART platform to avoid delays and won't waste time on the 14 when the 49 is waiting.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing a sax on the 21 bus, while a woman was knitting a scarf—perfectly normal here. San Francisco always finds a way to surprise.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think they can just stroll into a local bar and order a 'mojito' like in Cuba. Here, it's all about vermut and tapas; cocktails feel out of place.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still holding onto their map while trying to find the nearest metro, totally oblivious to all the locals casually ignoring the street performers.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the overground' when you hop on at Hackney Central. Locals know better!
Last night, a couple on the 133 bus was deep in a heated debate about which chicken shop does the best jerk. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh Döner and the sounds of laughter from the Kottbusser Tor park at midnight hit different. That's when I knew I belonged.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a techno party that starts at sunrise and ends with a spontaneous brunch in an abandoned factory. Pure magic!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they instinctively know to duck under the scaffolding on 16th to avoid the falling debris from some grand renovation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy hop onto a Muni bus, karaoke mic in hand, belting out 'I Will Survive' to a captive audience. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí fanfare; they miss the real gems tucked away in the alleys, like that little art gallery near Carrer de Fraternitat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion at the local bar's 'tapas aquí, caña allí' ordering system, still hesitant to mix wine with seafood.
